questions.subject: Indian Polity
questions.question: Which Fundamental Right is protected by Article 21 of the Constitution?
options: Protection of life and personal liberty
questions.explanation: Article 21 protects life and personal liberty except according to procedure established by law.

questions.subject: Indian Polity
questions.question: The Finance Commission is constituted under which Article of the Constitution?
questions.explanation: Article 280 provides for the constitution of a Finance Commission by the President.

questions.subject: History
questions.question: Who founded the Self-Respect Movement in Tamil Nadu?
questions.explanation: E.V. Ramasamy (Periyar) founded the Self-Respect Movement in 1925.

questions.subject: History
questions.question: The Battle of Plassey was fought in which year?
questions.explanation: The Battle of Plassey was fought in 1757 between the East India Company and Siraj-ud-Daulah's forces.

questions.subject: Geography
questions.question: Which river is known as the Dakshin Ganga?
questions.explanation: The Godavari is popularly called the Dakshin Ganga because of its length and importance in peninsular India.

questions.subject: Geography
questions.question: The Nilgiri Hills are located at the junction of which two major hill systems?
questions.explanation: The Nilgiri Hills lie where the Western and Eastern Ghats meet in southern India.

questions.subject: Economy
questions.question: Gross Domestic Product measures the value of final goods and services produced where?
options: By citizens anywhere in the world
Within the domestic territory of a country
questions.explanation: GDP measures final goods and services produced within a country's domestic territory during a period.

questions.subject: Economy
questions.question: Which institution is primarily responsible for monetary policy in India?
questions.explanation: The Reserve Bank of India conducts monetary policy through its statutory framework and Monetary Policy Committee.

questions.subject: Science
questions.question: Which blood cells help in clotting?
questions.explanation: Platelets, or thrombocytes, play a major role in blood clotting.

questions.subject: Science
questions.question: Photosynthesis mainly takes place in which cell organelle?
questions.explanation: Chloroplasts contain chlorophyll and are the principal sites of photosynthesis in plant cells.

questions.subject: Current Affairs & Environment
questions.question: Which gas is the largest contributor to human-caused global warming?
questions.explanation: Carbon dioxide is the largest contributor to anthropogenic warming because of the scale and persistence of emissions.

questions.subject: Environment
questions.question: A biosphere reserve is intended mainly to combine conservation with what?
questions.explanation: Biosphere reserves combine biodiversity conservation with sustainable use, research, education and local livelihoods.

questions.subject: Aptitude
questions.question: If 20% of a number is 50, what is the number?

questions.subject: Aptitude
questions.question: The average of 12, 18, 24 and 30 is:
questions.explanation: Their sum is 84; 84 ÷ 4 = 21.

questions.subject: Aptitude
questions.question: A sum of ₹1,000 earns simple interest at 10% per annum for 2 years. The interest is:

questions.subject: Aptitude
questions.question: What is the HCF of 24 and 36?
questions.explanation: The greatest common factor of 24 and 36 is 12.

questions.subject: Tamil
questions.question: 'யாதும் ஊரே யாவரும் கேளிர்' என்ற புகழ்பெற்ற வரியைப் பாடியவர் யார்?
questions.explanation: 'யாதும் ஊரே யாவரும் கேளிர்' என்பது கணியன் பூங்குன்றனாரின் புறநானூறு பாடல் வரியாகும்.

questions.subject: Tamil
questions.question: 'திருக்குறள்' இயற்றியவர் யார்?
questions.explanation: திருக்குறளை இயற்றியவர் திருவள்ளுவர்.

questions.subject: Tamil
questions.question: 'சிலப்பதிகாரம்' எந்த இலக்கிய வகையைச் சேர்ந்தது?
questions.explanation: சிலப்பதிகாரம் தமிழின் ஐம்பெரும் காப்பியங்களில் ஒன்றாகும்.

questions.subject: Tamil
questions.question: தமிழில் உயிரெழுத்துகளின் எண்ணிக்கை எத்தனை?
questions.explanation: தமிழில் 12 உயிரெழுத்துகள் உள்ளன.

questions.subject: Tamil Nadu
questions.question: Tamil Nadu's state animal is:
questions.explanation: The Nilgiri tahr is the state animal of Tamil Nadu.

questions.subject: Tamil Nadu
questions.question: Kallanai (Grand Anicut) was built across which river?
questions.explanation: Kallanai was constructed across the Kaveri River and is traditionally associated with Karikala Chola.

questions.subject: Indian National Movement
questions.question: The Non-Cooperation Movement was launched in which year?
questions.explanation: The Non-Cooperation Movement was launched under Gandhi's leadership in 1920.

questions.subject: Indian National Movement
questions.question: Who gave the slogan 'Swaraj is my birthright and I shall have it'?
questions.explanation: The slogan is famously associated with Bal Gangadhar Tilak.

questions.subject: General Science
questions.question: The SI unit of electric current is:
questions.explanation: The ampere (A) is the SI base unit of electric current.
